quotes.text: If the receiver returns a similar share, I'd get back about $7 of the $15, well above the $5 I'd have by keeping everything.
This could be the final round, where a receiver might keep more. Still, reciprocity has been steady, so I'll keep trusting.
That's slightly more than an even split, to reward their trust.

note: Payoff bookkeeping from totals drives rising sends to full; weighs end-game risk and keeps trusting.

quotes.text: That extra bit above an even split rewards the risk they took.

note: Short post-hoc rationales: always full send, return slightly above even split to reward sender's risk.
